artifacts.summary: Resolves PLACEMENT for the gate-enforced verbatim-fragment-duplication exclusion-class record: recommends a new agent-system/extensions/core/context/standards/gate-enforced-fragment-duplication.md file (index-entries.json only indexes context/, ruling out a docs/ placement), re-derives the lint's current six fragment-path variables as live evidence the derivation-rule constraint must stand (a hardcoded list would already be stale), documents both enforcing gates' exact mechanics, and captures baseline gate output for the implement-phase before/after diff.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system corpus, index-entries.json registers only context/-relative paths -- no docs/-prefixed path appears anywhere in its entries array. Any new discoverable record intended to be reachable via the context index must live under context/, not docs/, even when a docs/ file (e.g. docs/reference/standards/agent-frontmatter-standard.md) is topically closer to the subject matter.

agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh and lint-postflight-boundary.sh deliberately enforce verbatim markdown duplication at runtime: the former reads fragment-path variables (currently six: STANDARD_FILE, FRAGMENT_FILE, ARTIFACTS_TEMPLATE_FRAGMENT, PLAN_STATUS_OWNERSHIP_FRAGMENT, BOUNDED_WAIT_FRAGMENT, MODIFIED_FILES_FRAGMENT) and FAILs an in-scope agent contract lacking a verbatim copy; the latter asserts a literal heading via grep -qE '^## MUST NOT \(Postflight Boundary\)'. A corpus-dedup pass must derive the current exclusion set by reading these lints' own variables/regex at the time of the pass, never from a copied list, since the variable set has already grown once since it was first documented.
